in_sanskrit.name: Romah/Romaka
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rides in a chariot or travels extensively

in_marathi.name: Romit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Romit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Romit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Romah' which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'it' denotes power. Thus, the name Romit signifies a person who is powerful like a mountain.
